> ⚠️ **Privacy & Redaction Notice**
> Please **do NOT** paste private notes, personal journals, tokens, passwords, credentials, or raw unredacted device logs into public issues.
> If you have discovered a security vulnerability or sensitive privacy issue, report it privately to **yabp.support@gmail.com**.

**Describe the bug**
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Open NoteKar
2. Go to '...'
3. Tap on '...'
4. See error or unexpected behavior

**Expected behavior**
A clear description of what you expected to happen instead.

**Screenshots / Screen Recording**
If applicable, attach redacted screenshots or a short screen recording showing the issue. Ensure no private notes or personal information are visible.
